title: Research: close the P112 (5,3) beta residue
body:
## Summary

```text
Two arbitrary P112 six-flats + at most eight deleted lines
  -> at most three residual-rank-six directions
  -> all four pinned TWOSIDE (5,3) beta shapes excluded
```

Adds a scoped geometric theorem and its mixed-rank application. The newly closed shape is `4,5,6^6`, using quotient-basis weights `4,6,6`; the other three shapes already follow from separate predecessor results. This closes the stated cell under the pinned TWOSIDE hypotheses, not full C5 or `C(P112)>=64`. No supplier, selected result or kappa changes.

Sources are DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`, the retained E8/decoder lineage, and canonical main `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. The first commit preserves byte-identical excerpts; the second adds the proof, complete replay, receipts and dedicated CI. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-18998083).

## Evidence

- Before: the remaining `4,5,6^6` shape needs an eight-line small-piece cover, beyond the existing four-deletion premise. After: an exact dual-code census proves the eight-deletion maximum is three and the fundamental-circuit argument excludes it.
- All 788,035 annihilators, 776,805 distinct nonempty flat masks, 159 first-flat orbits and 123,511,995 representative pairs are covered. Every orbit row and an independent three-direction witness are committed. The separate deletion witness has union size twelve; common-set sharpness is not claimed.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, 36,864 exhaustive oracle comparisons and 14 behavioral groups pass, including optimized execution, malformed inputs, source/capacity failures, incomplete orbit coverage, altered receipts and a Git-free read-only export. Optimized Python 3.13 agrees exactly. The existing four-deletion maximum of one is independently reproduced.
- Strict native compiler diagnostics, Ruff, Python compilation, 16 assignment tests and publication-byte checks pass locally. Two read-only internal reviews found no objection. Hosted Linux CI and independent human/proof-kernel review are separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-mixed-rank-reduction
```

Requires a C++17 compiler; no third-party Python packages. Direct replay uses pinned local inputs without Git or network. Other cells and the complete decoder/supplier implications remain open.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. New research package and its dedicated workflow only.

Blast radius: research. Existing checkers, frozen sources and the selected record are unchanged.
